title: Ingest dryRun query parity + GitHub target shape fix
problem: POST /api/ingest/github|hackernews|reddit ignored ?dryRun=1 query (body-only). Ops probes using query form wrote live pain points. GitHub also rejected {owner,repo} and ignored targets[].
whyItMatters: Reliability — prevents accidental live ingest during hourly dry-run probes; keeps catalog growth intentional via scheduled job only.
